title: QUIC RFC 9000 0-RTT Packet Format Focused Proof Verification
verification_method: Focused S17P2P3 requirement-home tests, Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, and SpecTrace JSON validation.
scope: This verification covers focused 0-RTT packet-format parser and builder proof for the listed S17P2P3 requirements.
expected_result: S17P2P3 requirement-home tests prove the long-header 0-RTT type, first-byte bit fields, connection-ID length boundaries, Length and Packet Number field validation, first-flight 0-RTT ordering, suppression after 1-RTT processing, ACK exclusion, and remembered-limit error behavior.
procedure: Run the focused S17P2P3 requirement-home filter.
preconditions: Existing long-header parser behavior remains the canonical wire-format parser for version 1 0-RTT packets.
Existing 0-RTT packet builder behavior remains the canonical repository-owned client first-flight emission floor.
Remembered-limit proof is scoped to stream-state flow-control behavior.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim 0-RTT decryption/opening, complete remembered transport-parameter policy, or broader S17 packet-format closure outside the listed S17P2P3 requirements.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-04. The Release build passed with zero warnings, the focused S17P2P3 no-build filter passed 60/60, regenerated QUIC coverage triage marked all 23 S17P2P3 requirements trace_clean, and SpecTrace JSON validation passed for 355 artifacts.
